scope: Single coordination admission review of all 93 changed paths, all task product code/tests, pinned data/generation/provenance and local evidence. No full-suite rerun; no Git mutation, network publishing, business database or Actions.

findings.title: Buffer slice aliases break exact schema pin and frozen original-byte retention
findings.root_cause: Buffer is assignable to the public Uint8Array inputs, but Buffer.slice returns a shared view. Both input capture and defensive getters invoke overridable slice(), so validated bytes and pinned schema bytes remain caller-mutable.
impacts: After decode, caller Buffer or returned originalUtf8 Buffer mutation changes retained bytes while sha256 and value remain old.

During createCurrentCreditCodec, mutate WMS {0,29} to {0,99} after first await: the hash checks original bytes and the parser uses mutated bytes; 90-digit Money is accepted under the original WMS pin.
After frozen captureReplay, mutating caller Buffer changes stored request and response; changed request is accepted and HTTP200 returns altered non-JSON body.
findings.fix: Create intrinsic Uint8Array copies at every input ownership transfer and defensive getter; do not dispatch slice on caller subclasses. Add Buffer/subclass regressions for load, decode, captureOriginalBytes and C01/C02 capture/replay, including mutation during async awaits. Preserve all existing Uint8Array and original-byte semantics.
findings.existing_test_gap: Final TS tests construct Uint8Array/TextEncoder data, so mutation tests do not cover Buffer inputs.
findings.issue_note: Assigned by root coordinator; network publication not performed by this reviewer.

retained_nonblocking_risks.description: Exact interval overlap check is O(n^2); schema allows 200,000 ranges. Existing TS 1k/2k/4k probe retained; maximum and C# capacity not measured. No current HTTP/Owner wiring or capacity SLA. Requires exact sorted scan/capacity gate before consumer integration.
